about.title: Building clean and meaningful digital experiences
about.paragraph1: I am a motivated and dedicated professional with a solid background in Information Technology and Telecommunications, having recently completed my studies at the University of Peloponnese.
about.paragraph2: Beyond my academic experience, I have contributed to a variety of projects that allowed me to strengthen my technical skills and apply my knowledge in practical, real-world environments.
